description.narrative: The Projects developmental impact is achieved through: (i) Access to finance for SMEs, which, in recent years have increasingly resorted to alternative financing sources besides the banking system, such as leasing and other NBFIs. (ii) Access to climate finance, as IFC anticipates that the Project will further increase access to energy-efficiency and renewable-energy projects and transport technologies, using leasing as an alternative financial product, well suited to various climate mitigation-related financing; and (iii) Increase competitive pressures in the climate space in Romania, which will foster competition through the capacity building channel.

The proposed investment consists of up to EUR50 mn (approx. US$53 mn equivalent) senior unsecured loan to UniCredit Leasing Corporation IFN S.A. (UCLC or the Company). UCLC is part of UniCredit Group, a pan-European banking group with presence in Italy, Germany and Central and Eastern Europe. UCLC is the leader of the Romanian leasing market and an existing IFC client since 2017. The proceeds of IFCs investment are to be earmarked (i) up to 50% to support on-lending to small and medium enterprises (SMEs) and corporates in Romania, and (ii) at least 50% to funding eligible sustainable energy finance projects that meet eligibility criteria established by IFC (the Project).
